messages:
maria_sales: SirenProof signed NDA and asked for a short perf mini-bench next Wed. They want: smoke, sustained, and a couple microbursts. We need a one-pager for Ops, hosted vs Dedicated estimate, and KMS/audit wording for security. Can someone lead? :wave:

devon_se: I'll own the runbook. Short plan: smoke 10m @ 20 qps, sustained 25m @ 80 qps, 5 microbursts 20s @ 200 qps spaced 90s. Will publish JMeter script + tiny python harness. Test payload (share with buyer):

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","input":"Summarize: <SAMPLE>","max_tokens":160}
```

Add header X-RW-KV-Cache: false for cold-path. X-RW-Warm: true for warm-path.

tessops: Ops notes: Dedicated gives more consistent p99 during bursts. Hosted OK if we pre-warm and allow burst autoscale (recommend 2x burst nodes). Need their IP ranges and whether they require 99.95 SLA. KMS + audit logs are enterprise add-ons; ops needs a named contact for key rotation.

raj_eng: I'll monitor Prometheus + rtail. Please enable 1% trace sampling and token-level logging for the run window. Also enable p50/p95/p99 windows. I'll be on-call.

infra-bot: perf-harness v1.6 deployed to perf cluster by @infra-bot

maria_sales: Pricing snapshot for buyer: hosted token BEO ~$0.00042/gen-token -> 100k tokens ≈ $42 + ~$100 ops support. Dedicated small node ≈ $460/day. KMS & audit setup ≈ $500 one-time + $200/mo retention. I'll send schedule and request IPs + KMS contact. Thanks! :thumbsup:
